text:
Ivy: Heads-up: new perf-cycle announcement posted. Key changes include timezone-aware deadlines and an anonymous upward-feedback option. Managers please ACK by 09/15 EOD PT.
Marcus: link?
Ivy: /drive/people-ops/2026_cycle/Packet_Timezone_FINAL.pdf and Review_Template_Timezone.docx
Helen: timeline summary?
Ivy: review window opens 09/20 00:00 PT and closes 10/01 17:00 PT. Calibration 10/04-10/07. Appeals 10/11-10/15. Timezone-aware deadlines: forms lock at 17:00 local office time if manager/IC are in EMEA/APAC. See packet p.2 for mapping.
Marcus: anonymous upward feedback how will that work? concerns about abuse.
Ivy: optional anonymous upward feedback form hosted separately; People Ops will aggregate and redact before sharing with managers. Abuse policy in packet: people-ops reviews reports flagged for harassment; malicious submissions can be traced if necessary.
Raj: any change to evidence requirements?
Ivy: yes we now require an Evidence Summary (short paragraph per item) plus 2-5 attachments or links. Evidence Summary should be objective (dates, metrics, link). Also a short "context for promotions" checkbox that routes promo requests to Promotions workflow.
Marcus: managers on extended travel across timezones: interim reviewer rules?
Ivy: interim reviewer rules updated: if manager unavailable >72h during the window, assign interim reviewer; if interim reviewer is also out due to timezone overlap, People Ops will appoint a dedicated coverage reviewer. Use the exact interim wording from p.5.
Helen: what's the exact interim wording?
Ivy: paste from packet: "Interim reviewer statement: Primary manager unavailable; provisional reviewer compiled this submission from Evidence Summary, PRs, and peer notes dated MM/DD-MM/DD. Recommended band: X. Sources enumerated below." Please copy verbatim.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: Required templates: Review_Template_Timezone.docx and Evidence_Summary_Template.csv. Auto-reminders at 10 days, 72h, and 24h before local close.
Raj: export and PII concerns? we're dealing with customer info in attachments sometimes.
Ivy: export for chairs excludes contact details and redacts customer PII. Attachments flagged as "customer_data" must be sanitized; file naming guidance in packet. Export preview available on 10/02 for managers who request by 09/29.
Marcus: calibration decks required?
Ivy: optional. If used, name team_calibration_localtime.pdf and upload. Decks with slides containing salary data will be rejected.
Helen: dispute/appeal process?
Ivy: post-calibration dispute window is 5 business days. Use Dispute_Form_Timezone.docx. People Ops mediates; final decision by Head of People. Appeals citing procedural errors get priority.
Marcus: can we get a nightly missing-items digest by org region? helps chasing across timezones.
Ivy: yes people-ops will publish region-specific digests at 08:00 local time starting 09/25 and DM managers.
Raj: training? any new sessions for timezone logistics?
Ivy: scheduled two manager clinics: 09/18 09:00 PT and 09/19 16:00 GMT. Recordings will be posted. Attendance recommended for first-time managers.
PeopleOpsBot: Note: misuse of anonymous feedback or Confidential flags will trigger review.
Helen: ACK.
Marcus: ACK.
Raj: ACK.
